verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents a Raise disputes API for filing disputes on behalf of cardholders, and lists Dispute among its subscribable webhook types, so the core of programmatic filing and status tracking is covered. Evidence submission is documented only as a zip upload through the Customer Area, which is a pilot feature and not an API. Network reason codes and provisional credit handling do not appear anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: network reason code handling, programmatic (API) evidence submission, provisional credit handling, detail on dispute webhook status lifecycle through resolution, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution

citations.quote: Provide a UI for your cardholders to ask for their money back and to report fraudulent transactions and lost cards using the Raise disputes API
As a platform that issues cards through Adyen, you must be able to raise disputes on behalf of your cardholders.
You can subscribe to the following webhooks: Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, Report
Package dispute details and supporting information into a zip file and upload them through the Customer Area (pilot feature).
